# Nimendra's Notes

> A public digital garden of working notes on cloud infrastructure, software engineering, systems, and AI. Notes change as I learn.

These are personal notes, not a complete reference or a finished course. Some notes link to unpublished pages or documents. Use the published pages linked below to browse the site.

## Start here

- [Home](https://notes.nimendra.online/): Overview, topic links, and recently updated notes.
- [Tags](https://notes.nimendra.online/tags/): Browse published notes by tag.
- [Sitemap](https://notes.nimendra.online/sitemap.xml): Index of published pages for finding a specific note.

## Topics

- [AI and LLMs](https://notes.nimendra.online/00.fleeting-notes/ai-llm/): Notes on agents, language models, and practical AI systems.
- [Infrastructure as code](https://notes.nimendra.online/02.areas/devops/cac--and--iac/): Notes on provisioning and configuration management.
- [Docker](https://notes.nimendra.online/02.areas/devops/docker/): Containers, images, networking, and storage.
- [Kubernetes](https://notes.nimendra.online/02.areas/kubernetes/k8s-primer/): Cluster concepts and hands-on learning.
- [Platform engineering](https://notes.nimendra.online/02.areas/platform-engineering/): Internal platforms, developer experience, and related tools.
- [Go and software engineering](https://notes.nimendra.online/02.areas/software-engineering/go-notes/): Go language notes and software engineering fundamentals.
- [gRPC](https://notes.nimendra.online/02.areas/software-engineering/grpc/): Remote procedure calls, Protocol Buffers, and communication patterns.
- [Redis](https://notes.nimendra.online/01.projects/database-engineering/redis/): Data structures, messaging, clustering, and persistence.
- [Reliability and observability](https://notes.nimendra.online/00.fleeting-notes/site-reliability-engineering/): Notes on operating and understanding production systems.
- [System performance](https://notes.nimendra.online/00.fleeting-notes/system-perfomance/): Performance methods, Linux internals, and measurement tools.
- [Books](https://notes.nimendra.online/05.books/): Reading notes across technology, learning, and other subjects.
